name: Xenon ~Mugen no Shitai~
source:
Kouji, a Japanese high school student, experiences strange, recurrent life-like dreams. He finds himself in a space station inhabited by beautiful young women. As he tries to explore the dream realm he wakes up. His teacher, intrigued by his account of the bizarre adventure, urges him to travel back to the space station in his dream and report his discoveries to her. Eventually Kouji realizes that his dream and reality are tightly connected, and finds himself compelled to avert a grave danger.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/xenon-mugen-no-shitai]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
日本高中生宏治反复做着无比逼真的怪梦。梦中，他置身于一座只有美丽年轻女性居住的空间站；每当想要探索这个梦境世界，他便会突然醒来。老师听完这段离奇经历后大感兴趣，鼓励他再次进入梦中的空间站，并向自己报告发现。宏治最终意识到梦境与现实紧密相连，也不得不挺身阻止一场迫在眉睫的重大危机。

[译自 [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/xenon-mugen-no-shitai]MobyGames[/url]]
